rules.instruments: Long calls or long puts only. No spreads, no selling premium.
rules.selection: Underlying must have passed the day's gate stack (Fresh Buys green verdict or top Gated Longs for calls; Sell Mode names with a catalyst for puts). 2-3 picks per EOD, fewer if nothing qualifies - zero is a valid answer.
rules.contract_standards: Delta roughly 0.60-0.75 (in-the-money leaning, not lottery tickets), 45-90 days to expiry, tight bid/ask (mid fill must be realistic), open interest 100+. No holding through earnings unless the earnings IS the stated thesis and is flagged.
rules.sizing: Max $2,500 premium outlay per trade (half the $5k equity risk unit - long options routinely lose 100%, so the premium IS the risk). CAP EXCEPTION ADOPTED BY OMAR 2026-07-31 (proposed 7/30 after GE, the day's only gate-passer, had no contract satisfying both the cap and the quality floor): when the CHEAPEST quality-compliant contract (delta >= 0.60) on a gate-passing name costs more than $2,500, ONE single contract up to $3,000 is permitted, flagged 'cap_exception: true' on the trade every time, tallied in Friday reviews. Never a general raise; never more than one contract under the exception.
rules.exits: Every trade gets all three at entry: take-profit premium (default +100%), stop premium (default -50%), and a time exit at ~21 days to expiry regardless of P&L (theta decay accelerates there).
rules.timing: TWO-STEP (adopted 2026-07-29 after night one exposed stale-mark risk): the EOD run SELECTS - name, direction, strike, expiry, rough size from the closing book - and records the pick as status PLANNED with the close-book mid as planned_premium. The next morning ~8:50 AM CT (after opening-auction spreads settle, options live), the morning routine prices each PLANNED pick at the live TradeStation mid; that mid becomes the official entry_premium and status flips OPEN. Selection needs the closed daily bar; pricing needs an open market - never conflate the two.
rules.no_chase: At the morning fill, a PLANNED pick is VOIDED (status VOIDED, reason logged, stays on the record) if the underlying gapped against the thesis by more than 2%, or the live mid is more than 20% above the planned premium, or the contract no longer passes the liquidity/delta standards. Voids are logged picks, not deletions - they count in the Friday review.
rules.fills: Official paper entry = live bid/ask mid at the morning fill (~8:50 AM CT), never a stale after-hours mark. Daily mark = EOD mid (Yahoo closing book acceptable for marks - verified within pennies of TS on 7/29). Honest fills only - never mark at the ask on entry or bid on exit favorably. NIGHT-ONE EXCEPTION: the three 7/29 picks were recorded at stale close mids before this rule existed; their entries get restated at the 7/30 morning live mids per the verification report, correction logged.
rules.analysis_gates: UPGRADED 2026-07-29 (scripts/options_analysis.py runs on every candidate and every open trade): (1) Black-Scholes delta computed from the strike's own market IV - no moneyness eyeballing - must land 0.60-0.75; (2) IV/RV20 (option's implied vol vs the stock's realized 20-day movement) <= 1.4 pass, 1.4-1.8 flag as paying-up, > 1.8 reject unless a flagged catalyst justifies it; (3) breakeven move must fit inside the expected move to expiry (S*IV*sqrt(T)); (4) report the underlying move needed to double the premium by the time-exit and the weekly theta bleed as % of premium; (5) IV rank stays honestly n/a until research/iv-history.json accumulates ~60 sessions (collector runs at EOD) - never faked from proxies.
rules.data_validation: Every quote must pass the battery before it can become an entry or a mark: live bid > 0, market not crossed, mid >= intrinsic value (stale-quote tell), IV in the 5%-250% plausible band, spread <= 10% clean / 10-15% flag / > 15% REJECT, OI >= 100, cross-source spot agreement within 0.5% (scan close vs yfinance), last-trade freshness noted. A REJECT price never enters the ledger; the reasons are logged on the trade.
rules.prereg: Every new pick is committed to git the day it is made (anti-sycophancy mandate). No backdating, no silent deletions - a bad pick closes at its stop and stays on the record.
rules.readiness: ADDED 2026-07-29 (Omar: measure whether the stock is POISED to move soon in our direction): five direction-aware components, 20 pts each - volatility compression (Bollinger width percentile + TTM squeeze), distance to the 20-day trigger level, OBV volume accumulation, MACD histogram inflection, relative strength vs SPY at a 60-day extreme. UNCALIBRATED: ranks candidates (pick the higher score when gates tie), logged on every trade, graded in Friday reviews - it does NOT veto until measurement earns it that power. Context: our own studies showed ADX and the buyers-vs-sellers margin at pick time predict nothing - they stay gates only. PRIME SETUP tag = squeeze pctile <= 25 AND IV/RV <= 1.2 together (cheap premium + stored energy - the textbook long-options pairing); prefer these when available.
rules.regime_gate: ADDED 2026-07-29: overlay-level market filter (the one layer our own backtests proved carries edge - HQ Swing study). SPY vs its 200-day via options_analysis.market_regime(): PASS = normal; REPAIR (below the 200-day or it's falling) = new CALLS blocked unless the pick is a PRIME SETUP, puts fine; DEEP-FAIL (>10% below) = new calls blocked entirely, puts allowed but flagged late-trend. Applies to NEW picks only, never forces exits.
rules.macro_blackout: ADDED 2026-07-29: no NEW entries when the morning fill day is the day before or day of a macro binary - Fed decision, CPI, jobs report. Sources: research/macro-calendar-2026H2.json (FOMC published; CPI approximate - verify weekly) + first-Friday NFP computed. Earnings blackout (per-stock) already covered in contract_standards. Open positions get a heads-up in the brief, not a forced exit.
rules.concentration: ADDED 2026-07-29: max 2 open positions expressing the same theme. Every trade carries a `theme` tag set at pick time; three trades that are secretly one macro bet = one trade with extra steps. The EOD picker checks the tag before adding.
rules.exit_policy_test: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-29 (research/options-exit-policy-preregistration.md): Policy A (live rule) = sell all at +100%. Policy B (shadow) = bank half at +100%, trail the rest at 65% of peak mark. Every EOD mark appends {date, premium} to each open trade's mark_history so B computes with zero hindsight. Verdict at 30 closed trades by higher expectancy; ties go to A.
rules.kill_criteria: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-07-29: after 30 closed trades, negative Policy-A expectancy = overlay STOPS pending a pre-registered redesign. Any time: total paper P&L below -$12,500 (five max losses) = immediate pause + red-team. Numbers change only via an explained commit to the preregistration file - never retroactively. Check with options_analysis.py --scorecard.
